name: World Region: Imperial Fortress
purpose: World Map Region 5 Banner — Imperial Fortress.
description: Massive multi-tiered imperial citadel bristling with banners, elite guards, and diamond-locked treasuries.
prompt: A masterwork minimalist 2D flat vector panoramic game banner. Colossal multi-tiered solid pitch-black Shogun fortress castle on massive stone ramparts with waving samurai clan battle flags. Giant deep blood-red sun rising behind fortress towers. Pure solid pitch-black silhouettes (#000000), vibrant crimson red (#FF2035). High contrast, razor-sharp vector lines, no 3D rendering, no text, no watermark.
